literal: Every day having examined justice who does not do king every day country will be ruined.
translation: The country of a king who does not examine affairs and administer justice every day will fall into ruin day by day.
modern: ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் குற்றங்களை ஆராய்ந்து நீதி வழங்காத அரசனது நாடு, நாளுக்கு நாள் அழிந்து போகும்.
explanation: A king's primary duty is to actively oversee his administration and ensure justice is delivered continuously. If he fails to examine the daily affairs and correct wrongs, the foundation of his rule weakens. Consequently, his country will face steady and inevitable destruction day after day. The repetition of the word for 'every day' emphasizes that justice requires constant vigilance, not just occasional attention.
